newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Fegusa sees 710,000 T fertilizer output.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Fegusa sees 710,000 T fertilizer output.

text.p: Mexico's Fertilizantes Guadalajara SA (Fegusa) plans to produce 710,000 tonnes of fertilizer this year, marketing director Guillermo Ramirez said on Wednesday.
Mexico's top fertilizer exporter plans to produce 360,000 tonnes of ammonium sulfate and also begin producing granulated ammonium sulfate.
"This will make us more competitive...and converts us into the only Mexican suppliers of this product," Ramirez told Reuters.
Fegusa controls 35 percent of the domestic fertilizer market, of nitrates and phosphates and is Mexico's top exporter of ammonium sulfates, Ramirez said.
Ramirez said that as of May, the company had sold 6,500 tonnes of sulfates to New Zealand, 1,500 tonnes to Dominican Republic and 30,000 tonnes to El Salvador.
The company recently began its first exports to the United States, where it sent 1,000 tonnes of ammonium sulfate to south Texas, he added.
